City Council Meeting
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA City Council Meeting
November 28, 2017 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
RECOGNITION OF A 90TH BIRTHDAY - It is recommended the City Council present Joan M. Landre with a 90th birthday recognition certificate.
6.1 Recognition of a 90th Birthday
6.2
RECOGNITION OF CALIFORNIA INK, PRINTING & GRAPHICS - It is recommended the City Council recognize California Ink, Printing & Graphics for its 25th anniversary and present owner Bill Sanders with a Certificate of Appreciation and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
6.2 Business Recognition
6.4
RECOGNITION OF LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT LIEUTENANT KEVIN BEGGS - It is recommended the City Council recognize Lieutenant Kevin Beggs for his years of service and present him with a Certificate of Recognition.
6.4 Recognition of Lt. Kevin Beggs
6.3
RECOGNITION OF LIBRARY BOOKMARK CONTEST WINNERS - It is recommended the City Council and Acting Library Manager Laura Valdivia recognize the bookmark contest winners.

INTRODUCTION OF NEW FULL-TIME EMPLOYEE - It is recommended the City Council welcome Dewayne Betts, and present him with a $40.00 gift certificate to Polly's Pie Restaurant, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.

7.2
APPOINTMENT TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council appoint Russell Hall to the La Mirada Community Foundation for an unexpired term ending in May 2019.

8.3 Treasurer Report

8.4 Investment Report

MEALS ON WHEELS FUNDING REQUEST FOR FISCAL YEARS 2017-18 AND 2018-19 - It is recommended the City Council approve funding in the amount of $9,000 for Fiscal Years 2017-18 and 2018-19 to Meals On Wheels and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement with Meals On Wheels on behalf of the City.
8.5 Meals on Wheels Funding Request

FUNDING REQUEST FOR FISCAL YEARS 2017-18 AND 2018-19 - It is recommended the City Council approve Straight Talk, Inc.â€™s Fiscal Years 2017-18 and 2018-19 funding request in the amount of $58,381 per fiscal year and in-kind contributions of $47,688 per fiscal year and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
8.6 Straight Talk, Inc. Funding Request
8.7
APPROVAL OF AN AGREEMENT WITH AQUATIC DESIGN GROUP, INC. FOR DESIGN AND ARCHITECTURAL SERVICES FOR THE SPLASH!
LA MIRADA REGIONAL AQUATICS CENTER WATER SLIDE PROJECT - It is recommended the City Council approve the selection of Aquatic Design Group, Inc. to provide design and architectural services for the Splash! water slide feature project in the amount of $203,930; direct the City Attorney to prepare an agreement with Aquatic Design Group, Inc.; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City and approve additional work up to 10 percent of the contract amount.

9.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 703 REPEALING REGULATIONS APPLICABLE TO GARAGE SALE DEPOSITS, AND AMENDING TITLE 9 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 703 repealing regulations applicable to garage sale deposits, and amending Title 9 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.1 Ordinance No. 703 - 2nd Reading

SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 704 REAUTHORIZING AND READOPTING THE CITY'S PUBLIC, EDUCATIONAL, AND GOVERNMENTAL ACCESS SUPPORT FEE - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 704 reauthorizing and readopting the City's public, educational, and governmental access support fee, by title only, and waive further reading.
